## Evidence maintenance

1. Add or update a claim ID in the architecture page.
2. Link the smallest relevant source or test evidence at the reviewed commit.
3. Mark configuration-sensitive behaviour as **environment-dependent**.
4. Add the reviewer role and unresolved question to the pull request.
5. Update links when source lines move; do not change the historical baseline of
   an already released documentation version.

## Evidence not yet available

The following evidence is intentionally not claimed:

- an authoritative supported-platform matrix;
- runtime traces for Access and SQL Server deployments;
- a complete database constraint, transaction, and concurrency model;
- threat-model approval or credential-storage remediation;
- accessibility testing with assistive technologies;
- acceptance by any regional body, member state, or national authority.
